integrity_notes: The proof is analytic and self-contained. The exact-rational checker supplies finite corroboration, not an infinite-domain or independent certification. No authorship or external endorsement is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Complete only for a four-vertex undirected cycle with three unit edge costs and one variable positive edge-cost ratio.
All four transition rates must be nonnegative and satisfy one exact linear budget; no bounded-rate or positive-lower-bound constraints are imposed.
Classifies the exact second Laplacian eigenvalue, not other mixing norms, general reversible chains, or longer cycles.
General convex/semidefinite formulations and the equal-cost cycle solution belong to earlier work.
Possible equivalence to older specialized eigenvalue optimization literature remains an originality risk.
title: A sharp shortcut-cost phase transition for fastest mixing on a four-vertex cycle
